title: Tracking toxicity of copper oxide nanoparticles (CuO NPs) on PGPR Bacillus megaterium in the presence of melatonin
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,4314-4326
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00300H, Paper
Gyan Datta Tripathi, Zoya Javed, Kavya Dashora
